## Summary
- reject empty, absolute, and parent-directory artifact references in the controller runtime evidence summarizer
- apply the same validation to per-observation artifact mappings before a summary can be produced
- update the controller runtime gate docs to require evidence-bundle-relative artifact paths

## Verification
- PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_controller_runtime
- PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -m unittest scripts.tests.test_controller_runtime_readiness scripts.tests.test_controller_runtime_readiness_redaction
- PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_controller_runtime scripts.tests.test_controller_runtime_readiness scripts.tests.test_controller_runtime_readiness_redaction
- git diff --check
- printf invalid absolute artifact JSON into PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -m vibescreen_evidence.controller_runtime - --run-id bad-absolute-path and confirmed exit 1

This is an offline fail-closed evidence hardening change only. It does not claim or close controller runtime acceptance; the real gate still requires physical controller hardware and a signed, entitled Host runtime.
title: Harden controller runtime artifact evidence paths
